proposal.reason: Main change is in proxy-based FD exchange logic: adds pidfd fallback when UDS send/recv is unavailable, new proxy message handling (GetFd/QueryFd/CloseFd), and proxy-service lifecycle/cleanup/error-path changes in src/proxy.cc and ipc socket support. transport is additionally required because src/transport/p2p.cc changes P2P registration/import behavior to integrate pidfd-imported FDs and ownership cleanup for registered/user buffers.
